note: A large aquatic herbivorous mammal, especially a manatee or dugong; not a cow.

senses.m: A large aquatic herbivorous mammal, especially a manatee or dugong
senses.pat: a sea cow grazes · sea-cow habitat · protect sea cows
ex: A dugong, sometimes called a sea cow, fed on seagrass.
Một con bò biển dugong, đôi khi được gọi là sea cow, ăn cỏ biển.
The sanctuary protects manatees and other sea cows.
Khu bảo tồn bảo vệ lợn biển và các loài bò biển khác.

note: A large eared seal that can use its fore flippers to move on land; different species inhabit the Pacific and southern oceans.

senses.m: A large eared seal that can use its fore flippers to move on land
senses.pat: a sea lion barks · a colony of sea lions · sea-lion rookery
ex: Sea lions rested on the rocks near the harbor.
Sư tử biển nằm nghỉ trên những tảng đá gần bến cảng.
The sea lion dived into the water to catch a fish.
Sư tử biển lặn xuống nước bắt cá.

note: To close an area so people cannot enter or leave, usually for safety or security.

senses.m: To close an area so people cannot enter or leave, usually for safety or security
senses.pat: seal off a street · be sealed off by police · seal an area off
ex: Police sealed off the street after the gas leak.
Cảnh sát phong tỏa con phố sau vụ rò rỉ khí gas.
The building was sealed off during the investigation.
Tòa nhà bị phong tỏa trong cuộc điều tra.

note: A period in old age when someone is said to become childlike or dependent; dated and potentially patronizing, so use only with care.

senses.m: A period in old age when someone is said to become childlike or dependent
senses.pat: enter a second childhood · describe old age as a second childhood
ex: The phrase second childhood can sound dismissive of older people.
Cụm “thời thơ ấu thứ hai” có thể mang sắc thái xem nhẹ người cao tuổi.
The memoir describes his renewed curiosity in later life without using the label.
Hồi ký kể về sự tò mò trở lại của ông khi về già mà không dùng nhãn gọi đó.

note: A council responsible for security policy; often refers specifically to the United Nations Security Council (UNSC).

senses.m: A council responsible for security policy
senses.pat: the UN Security Council · a security council meeting · Security Council resolution
ex: The Security Council debated the draft resolution.
Hội đồng Bảo an thảo luận dự thảo nghị quyết.
The country took its seat on the Security Council.
Quốc gia đó đảm nhận ghế thành viên Hội đồng Bảo an.

note: Money paid in advance to cover possible damage, unpaid rent, or other obligations; rules for holding and returning it vary by jurisdiction.

senses.m: Money paid in advance to cover possible damage, unpaid rent, or other obligations
senses.pat: pay/refund a security deposit · a rental security deposit · return the deposit
ex: The landlord returned the security deposit after the inspection.
Chủ nhà hoàn lại tiền đặt cọc sau khi kiểm tra.
The lease explains how the security deposit may be used.
Hợp đồng thuê nhà giải thích khoản đặt cọc có thể được sử dụng như thế nào.

note: The time required for a storage device or mechanism to locate requested data or a position; commonly used in computing and engineering.

senses.m: The time required for a storage device or mechanism to locate requested data or a position
senses.pat: disk seek time · reduce seek time · average seek time
ex: The new drive has a shorter seek time.
Ổ đĩa mới có thời gian tìm kiếm ngắn hơn.
Seek time affects how quickly a mechanical disk accesses data.
Thời gian tìm kiếm ảnh hưởng đến tốc độ ổ đĩa cơ truy cập dữ liệu.

note: An older adult, especially one eligible for certain benefits; can sound euphemistic or impersonal, so older adult may be preferred.

senses.m: An older adult, especially one eligible for certain benefits
senses.pat: senior-citizen discount · services for senior citizens · senior citizen center
ex: The museum offers a discount for senior citizens.
Bảo tàng giảm giá cho người cao tuổi.
The program helps older adults remain active in their communities.
Chương trình giúp người lớn tuổi duy trì hoạt động trong cộng đồng.

note: A secondary school for older students, commonly grades 10–12 in some US systems; structure differs across countries.

senses.m: A secondary school for older students, commonly grades 10–12 in some US systems
senses.pat: attend senior high school · senior-high-school student · graduate from senior high
ex: He is a senior high school student in Taiwan.
Cậu là học sinh trung học phổ thông ở Đài Loan.
The school offers vocational programs for senior high students.
Trường có các chương trình nghề cho học sinh trung học phổ thông.

note: To distinguish or remove one part from a group or mixture.

senses.m: To distinguish or remove one part from a group or mixture
senses.pat: separate out the useful data · separate something out from · be separated out
ex: The analyst separated out the regional sales figures.
Chuyên viên phân tích tách riêng số liệu bán hàng theo khu vực.
The machine separates out recyclable materials.
Máy tách riêng các vật liệu có thể tái chế.

note: A quality that makes someone seem sexually attractive; subjective and often used in media or popular culture.

senses.m: A quality that makes someone seem sexually attractive
senses.pat: have sex appeal · a sense of sex appeal · sex appeal in advertising
ex: The magazine discussed the actor’s screen presence and sex appeal.
Tạp chí bàn về phong thái trên màn ảnh và sức hấp dẫn giới tính của diễn viên.
The campaign relied on humor rather than sex appeal.
Chiến dịch dựa vào sự hài hước thay vì sức hấp dẫn giới tính.

note: A person treated or represented mainly as an object of sexual desire, ignoring their agency or other qualities; critical term.

senses.m: A person treated or represented mainly as an object of sexual desire, ignoring their agency or other qualities
senses.pat: portray someone as a sex object · objectification as a sex object
ex: The review criticized the film for portraying women as sex objects.
Bài phê bình chỉ trích bộ phim khắc họa phụ nữ như đối tượng tình dục.
The campaign challenged advertising that reduces people to sex objects.
Chiến dịch phản đối quảng cáo hạ thấp con người thành đối tượng tình dục.

note: Printed or written musical notation for one or more instruments or voices.

senses.m: Printed or written musical notation for one or more instruments or voices
senses.pat: read/play from sheet music · a sheet-music score · buy sheet music
ex: The pianist placed the sheet music on the stand.
Nghệ sĩ piano đặt bản nhạc lên giá.
The choir received sheet music for the new arrangement.
Ca đoàn nhận bản nhạc cho phần phối khí mới.

note: A confidence trick in which an object is hidden under one of several shells or cups and moved to deceive observers; figuratively, a deceptive rearrangement.

senses.m: A confidence trick in which an object is hidden under one of several shells or cups and moved to deceive observers
senses.pat: play/run a shell game · a political shell game · expose the shell game
ex: The police warned tourists about a shell game scam.
Cảnh sát cảnh báo du khách về trò lừa tráo vật dưới cốc.
Critics called the accounting changes a shell game.
Những người chỉ trích gọi các thay đổi kế toán là trò đánh tráo.

note: A historical term for psychological trauma experienced by soldiers in war, often associated with what is now called PTSD; outdated as a clinical diagnosis.

senses.m: A historical term for psychological trauma experienced by soldiers in war, often associated with what is now called PTSD
senses.pat: suffer shell shock · shell-shocked soldiers · the history of shell shock
ex: The novel depicts soldiers affected by shell shock.
Cuốn tiểu thuyết khắc họa những người lính bị chấn thương tâm lý do chiến tranh.
Modern clinicians use diagnoses such as PTSD rather than shell shock.
Các nhà lâm sàng hiện dùng chẩn đoán như PTSD thay cho thuật ngữ shell shock.

note: A keyboard key that temporarily changes the function of other keys, commonly producing uppercase letters or alternate symbols.

senses.m: A keyboard key that temporarily changes the function of other keys, commonly producing uppercase letters or alternate symbols
senses.pat: press/hold the Shift key · Shift-key combination · use Shift with a letter
ex: Hold the Shift key while typing the letter.
Giữ phím Shift khi gõ chữ cái.
The shortcut uses Shift and the arrow keys.
Phím tắt này dùng Shift cùng các phím mũi tên.

note: A controversial term with different meanings: electroconvulsive therapy in psychiatry (now usually called ECT), or abrupt economic/political reform. Specify the context.

senses.m: A controversial term with different meanings: electroconvulsive therapy in psychiatry (now usually called ECT), or abrupt economic/political reform
senses.pat: electroconvulsive shock therapy · economic shock therapy · undergo shock therapy
ex: The article describes the history of electroconvulsive therapy.
Bài báo mô tả lịch sử liệu pháp điện giật.
The government introduced rapid economic reforms known as shock therapy.
Chính phủ đưa ra các cải cách kinh tế nhanh được gọi là liệu pháp sốc.

note: Military troops trained and equipped to lead an attack; figuratively, an energetic group leading a campaign. Historical usage may be associated with particular armies.

senses.m: Military troops trained and equipped to lead an attack
senses.pat: deploy shock troops · shock troops led the advance · political shock troops
ex: Shock troops led the assault on the position.
Lực lượng xung kích dẫn đầu cuộc tấn công vào vị trí đó.
The campaign’s volunteers became its shock troops.
Các tình nguyện viên trở thành lực lượng tiên phong của chiến dịch.

note: A place where people shoot at targets for amusement or practice; also figurative for a dangerous area exposed to gunfire.

senses.m: A place where people shoot at targets for amusement or practice
senses.pat: a fairground shooting gallery · practice at a shooting gallery · a shooting-gallery target
ex: They tried the shooting gallery at the fair.
Họ thử trò bắn bia ở hội chợ.
The exposed checkpoint became a shooting gallery.
Trạm kiểm soát trống trải trở thành nơi hứng đạn.

note: A bag used to carry purchases; may be reusable, paper, plastic, or fabric.

senses.m: A bag used to carry purchases
senses.pat: carry a shopping bag · reusable shopping bag · put groceries in a bag
ex: She brought a reusable shopping bag to the market.
Cô mang túi mua sắm tái sử dụng đến chợ.
The cashier packed the groceries into two shopping bags.
Thu ngân cho hàng tạp hóa vào hai túi mua sắm.
